title: We have Sure Fit covers on our love seat and sofa
text: We have Sure Fit covers on our love seat and sofa. This slipcover is very bland in appearance, and does nothing for my living room's decor. I will say to be careful of the measurements, and confess I wasn't precise enough in understanding whether or not this would fit our chair - it does not (this might also be owing to the "relaxed" nature of the cover). Even if it did fit, though, the material itself is very uncomfortable - not breathable, and a bit scratchy. I would not want to sit on it for any length of time. The white piping and the ties do add at least some detail, and I appreciated the tabs showing where each section was supposed to go - even though it was still very cumbersome to try to get everything aligned just right. Mainly because of the bland style and the uncomfortable material, I won't be using this cover. We have Sure Fit covers on our love seat and sofa, and have been very pleased with their design and fabric quality, so we'll stick with them.
